msgStgAboutDesc: samfuri ne na aikace-aikacen Rust na yaiol.
msgStgFfmpegCheckFailed: Ba a iya kaiwa yaiol don bincika sabon sigar ba.
msgStgFfmpegExplain: Yana sauke ffmpeg {version} (kimanin {size} MB) daga {source} kuma ya girka shi don duk aikace-aikacen yaiol.
tipMainAdd: Ƙara hanyoyin haɗi daga allon rubutu
tipMainClear: Cire abubuwan da aka gama saukewa daga jerin
msgMainListEmpty: Kwafi hanyar haɗi, sannan danna + a sama. Jerin waƙoƙi yana zama jere ɗaya ga kowane bidiyo.
tipMainPresetVideo: Ana amfani da shi don hanyar haɗi zuwa bidiyo: hoton da sauti, a wane tsari
tipMainPresetAudio: Ana amfani da shi don hanyar haɗi zuwa sauti kawai (SoundCloud da makamantansu): a wane tsari
tipMainFolder: Jakar da abubuwan da aka sauke ke zuwa
tipMainOverwrite: Abin da za a yi idan fayil ɗin ya riga ya kasance a cikin babban fayil
tipMainShowFile: Nuna fayil a cikin babban fayil
msgMainToolsMissing: Ana shigar da yt-dlp da ffmpeg. Zazzagewa zai fara da zaran an gama.
msgStgYtdlpCheckFailed: Ba a iya samun GitHub don bincika sabon sigar ba.
msgStgYtdlpExplain: Yana sauke yt-dlp {version} daga GitHub kuma ya girka shi don duk aikace-aikacen yaiol.
msgStgDenoNone: Ba a shigar da Deno ba.
msgStgDenoCheckFailed: Ba a iya samun GitHub don bincika sabon sigar ba.
msgStgDenoExplain: Yana sauke Deno {version} daga GitHub kuma ya shigar da shi don duk aikace-aikacen yaiol. Bidiyoyin YouTube suna bukatarsa.
msgMngReorderHint: Ja shigarwa don canza tsari. Ana amfani da tsari iri ɗaya a cikin jerin taga.
lblStgLogin: Yi amfani da shigar shafina idan wani shafi ya buƙata
msgStgLoginExplain: Sai dai idan bidiyo yana buƙatar ka shiga (mai iyakacin shekaru, na membobi kawai): yt-dlp yana karanta shigar shafin daga wani shafi a kan wannan PC, Firefox farko. Ba a karanta komai sai wannan, kuma baya zuwa ko'ina sai ga wannan shafin.
msgDstNameHint: Danna suna don ƙara shi. Slash yana yin babban fayil na ciki.
msgStgCookiesExplain: Fayil ɗin cookies.txt da aka fitar daga burauzar da ka shiga. Ana amfani da shi da farko, kawai idan bidiyo yana buƙatar ka shiga. Wannan shine shigarka: kiyaye shi a asirce kuma ka goge shi idan ka gama.
msgStgTagExplain: Yana ƙara take, mai zane, kundin waƙa, lambar waƙa, nau'i, shekara da murfin zuwa fayilolin sauti da kake saukewa, da adireshin shafin a matsayin sharhi. Idan fayil ɗin ya riga ya ɗauki Suno id a cikin sharhinsa, ana kuma kwafin id ɗin zuwa tag ɗin YAIOL_AIID kafin a maye gurbin sharhin. Kundin waƙa da lambar waƙa an san su ne kawai don saiti a kan shafin kiɗa kamar SoundCloud.
msgDstSetFolderHint: Lokacin da ka ƙara saiti (jerin waƙoƙi ko kundin waƙoƙi), fayilolinsa za su shiga cikin karamin fayil mai suna kamar saitin.
msgDstSetPatternHint: Danna suna don ƙara shi. 'set' shine taken kundin ko jerin waƙoƙi, 'year' da 'date' sune lokacin da aka fitar da shi (kamar yadda shafin ya ce), 'uploader' shine wanda ya buga shi. Sunan da shafin bai bayar ba za a bar shi.
